Minimal dbt-duckdb project used only by `tests/cli/test_dbt_mcp_live.py`
(gated `FLUID_DBT_MCP_LIVE=1`) to drive the real dbt-labs/dbt-mcp server over
stdio against a local project. `profiles.yml` is generated by the test into a
temp dir (it needs an absolute duckdb path), so it is NOT committed here.
